summary: 罗马——芬兰运营商 Iceye 向意大利火箭制造商 Avio 提出了 20 亿欧元现金报价（合 22 亿美元），该报价将整合欧洲的太空能力，并让 Iceye 负责 Avio 向美国导弹业务的扩张。拟议的交易符合减少对外部供应商的依赖并缩小与美国和中国行业领导者之间日益扩大的差距的努力。 “欧洲对主权太空和国防能力的需求正在增长。满足这一需求的工业能力建设需要数年时间，这使得现在投资至关重要，”Iceye 周二表示。菲
content:
罗马——芬兰运营商 Iceye 向意大利火箭制造商 Avio 提出了 20 亿欧元现金报价（合 22 亿美元），该报价将整合欧洲的太空能力，并让 Iceye 负责 Avio 向美国导弹业务的扩张。拟议的交易符合减少对外部供应商的依赖并缩小与美国和中国行业领导者之间日益扩大的差距的努力。 “欧洲对主权太空和国防能力的需求正在增长。满足这一需求的工业能力建设需要数年时间，这使得现在投资至关重要，”Iceye 周二表示。该公司表示，将在五年内向意大利 Avio 投资 10 亿欧元，以扩大 Avio Vega 火箭的客户群。芬兰政府支持这一提议，芬兰国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁表示，“如果完成……将创建一个全球航天工业参与者，通过它，芬兰和整个欧洲国防的自给自足的供应安全将上升到一个新的水平。” Avio 周二表示正在考虑这一收购要约，而拥有 Avio 18% 股份的意大利国家控股国防集团 Leonardo 的首席执行官表示，他对这一收购要约感到“惊喜”，并将予以考虑。 Avio 董事会于周二举行了第一次会议，并表示已开始评估此次出价，Iceye 表示，该出价较该意大利集团周一收盘价溢价 21.3%，较其三个月成交量加权平均价溢价 34.8%。
除了欧洲航天发射活动外，Avio 也是导弹固体火箭发动机的市场领导者。9 月，该公司在弗吉尼亚州赫特的美国新设施破土动工，以实现为美国导弹生产带来急需的额外产能的雄心。 Avio 已与雷神公司合作生产 Mk 104 双推力火箭发动机，并与洛克希德·马丁公司合作在 Hurt 为洛克希德的增程 GMLRS (ER GMLRS) 和精确打击导弹 (PrSM) 项目生产发动机。 Avio 发言人告诉《防务新闻》，如果 Iceye 收购，则需要美国政府的批准以及意大利政府的批准。 9月，Avio宣布9个月的订单额为2.37亿欧元，其中一半与国防相关，其余主要与其Vega C和Vega E发射器有关。 Iceye 表示，其每股 41 欧元的报价将通过全资意大利子公司 Iris 2 发起，目的是使该公司退市。消息传出后，Avio 股价上涨超过 15%，至 39.5 欧元左右。 Iceye 自 2022 年以来一直向乌克兰提供卫星雷达图像，上个月与诺基亚和乌克兰国防部签署了一份意向书，探讨太空合作，包括主权卫星通信。
Iceye首席执行官拉法尔·莫德热夫斯基(Rafal Modrzewski)在赫尔辛基的一次活动上发表讲话时表示，该公司在发起竞标之前已与包括政府在内的相关各方进行了磋商，并且还需要几个月的时间才能完成交易。“这是一次非凡的能力组合……遵循相当明确的行业趋势，带来了全面的垂直整合，”莫德热夫斯基表示，并补充说这对两家公司都有利。材料来自路透社，作者 Giulia Segreti 和 Essi Lehto。

【原文 English Original】
ROME — Finnish operator Iceye has a made €2 billion cash offer ($2.2 billion) for Italian rocket maker Avio which would integrate Europe’s space capabilities as well as putting Iceye in charge of Avio’s expansion into the U.S. missile business. The proposed deal fits with efforts to reduce reliance on external providers and narrow a widening gap with industry leaders in the U.S. and China. “Europe’s need for sovereign space and defense capabilities is growing. Building the industrial capacity to meet that demand takes years, which makes it critical to invest now,” said Iceye on Tuesday. The firm said it would invest €1 billion in Avio in Italy over five years in a bid to expand the customer base of Avio’s Vega rocket. The Finnish government backed the offer, with Finnish Defense Minister Antti Hakkanen stating, “If completed … a global space industry player will be created, through which the self-sufficient security of supply of Finland’s and all of Europe’s defense will rise to a new level.” Avio said on Tuesday it was considering the offer, while the CEO of Italian state controlled defense group Leonardo, which owns an 18% percent stake in Avio, said he was “pleasantly surprised” by the bid and would consider it. Avio’s board held a first meeting on Tuesday and said it had started assessing the bid, which Iceye said offered a 21.3% premium to the Italian group’s closing price on Monday or a 34.8% premium to its three-month volume-weighted average price. Apart from its European space launch activity, Avio is also a market leader in solid rocket motors for missiles. In September it broke ground in Hurt, Virginia, on a new U..S facility to fulfill an ambition to bring much needed extra capacity to U.S. missile production. Avio has already partnered with Raytheon on production of the Mk 104 dual-thrust rocket motor and has teamed with Lockheed Martin to produce motors at Hurt for Lockheed’s Extended Range GMLRS (ER GMLRS) and Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) programs. An Avio spokesman told Defense News that U.S. government approval would be required in the event of a takeover by Iceye, as well as Italian government approval. In September, Avio announced a nine month order intake of €237 million, of which half was defense related, with the remainder mainly related to its Vega C and Vega E launchers. Iceye said its €41-per-share offer will be launched through wholly owned Italian subsidiary Iris 2 with the aim of delisting the company. Avio shares climbed more than 15% to around €39.5 on the news. Iceye has supplied Ukraine with satellite radar imagery since 2022, and last month signed a letter of intent with Nokia and Ukraine’s Defence Ministry to explore cooperation in space, including sovereign satellite communications. Speaking at an event in Helsinki, Iceye CEO Rafal Modrzewski said the company had held consultations with the parties involved, including governments, before launching the bid, and that it would take a few more months to close the transaction. “It’s a phenomenal combination of capabilities … bringing a full vertical integration, following quite clear industry trends,” Modrzewski said, adding that it would be beneficial for both companies. With material from Reuters by Giulia Segreti and Essi Lehto.

The first “Quad” leaders’ summit involving U.S. President Donald Trump should help dispel doubts about the bloc’s durability — for now — while providing a solid win for Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi as her administration focuses on the need to boost economic security cooperation.
Trump joined his three fellow Quad leaders for their first summit in two years on Tuesday, with the bloc expressing “grave concerns” about economic coercion and announcing a new maritime security initiative while touting investments in artificial intelligence.
“Our countries are the four corners of a free, open, stable and prosperous Indo-Pacific,” Trump said.

title: The United States’ Participation in the 2026 East Asia Summit
zh_title: 美国参加2026年东亚峰会
summary: 发言人办公室 美国参加2026年东亚峰会情况介绍 2026年11月18日 在11月17日于菲律宾马尼拉举行的东亚峰会上，美国重申对自由开放印太的承诺，表示支持东盟中心地位，并强调美国是该地区首选的能源和技术伙伴。为在美国与东盟建立关系50周年之前推进全面战略伙伴关系，美国和东盟通过了《落实美国-东盟领导人共识的全面工作计划》
content:
发言人办公室 美国参加2026年东亚峰会情况介绍 2026年11月18日 在11月17日于菲律宾马尼拉举行的东亚峰会上，美国重申对自由开放印太的承诺，表示支持东盟中心地位，并强调美国是该地区首选的能源和技术伙伴。为了在美国-东盟关系成立50周年之前推进全面战略伙伴关系，美国和东盟通过了《实施美国-东盟领导人共同愿景声明的综合工作计划，以促进东盟和美国更强大、更安全和更繁荣》（2026-2030年）。美国强调其与盟友和伙伴一道致力于加强威慑，以维护印太地区的和平与稳定。在两国建交80周年之际，美国祝贺菲律宾成功担任东盟轮值主席国。促进和平，加强自由开放的印太地区 美国将继续在印太地区发挥领导作用，并威慑该地区任何试图通过武力解决争端的国家，这体现了特朗普总统通过实力实现和平的承诺。
美国将继续维护《联合国海洋法公约》所反映的国际法规定的所有国家行使航行和飞越自由的权利，包括在南中国海。台海的和平与稳定对于印太地区的安全与繁荣仍然至关重要，美国反对任何单方面改变现状的行为。美国仍然致力于实现朝鲜完全无核化，并全面执行联合国安理会所有涉朝决议。扩大贸易、能源和技术联系美国仍然是东盟最大的单一国家外国直接投资者，截至 2025 年，该地区的外国直接投资超过 5,570 亿美元，为美国提供了约 532,000 个就业岗位。美国祝贺东盟领导人签署《数字经济框架协议》，该协议有可能为美国科技公司提供更大的机会，让该地区的数字经济到2030年将达到2万亿美元。随着美国超级智能（SI）技术在全球树立黄金标准，美国正在与东南亚伙伴合作，扩大获得美国技术的机会，包括通过美国-东盟SI SPARK计划，这将有助于释放该地区的经济潜力。
通过签署《人工智能机会声明》，越南和柬埔寨与其他国家一道致力于促进基于可信赖伙伴关系的创新。为了支持该地区的人工智能准备工作，美国将与印度尼西亚政府、东盟秘书处和卡内基梅隆大学合作，于 12 月在雅加达举办东盟人工智能周。美国和菲律宾签署了一项为期五年的经济繁荣和韧性战略目标协议，该协议将动员对包括吕宋经济走廊在内的关键基础设施的投资，并与可靠的合作伙伴一起确保供应链的安全。作为世界上最大的能源生产国之一，美国可以为东南亚几代人的增长提供动力。美国准备与东盟合作加强该地区的能源安全

【原文 English Original】
Office of the Spokesman The United States’ Participation in the 2026 East Asia Summit Fact Sheet November 18, 2026 At the East Asia Summit in Manila, Philippines on November 17, the United States reaffirmed its commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific, expressed support for ASEAN centrality, and underscored the United States as the region’s preferred partner for energy and technology. To advance their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership ahead of the 50 th anniversary of U.S.-ASEAN relations, the United States and ASEAN adopted the Comprehensive Work Plan to Implement the U.S.-ASEAN Leaders’ Joint Vision Statement to Promote a Stronger, Safer, and More Prosperous ASEAN and America (2026-2030). The United States highlighted its commitment, with allies and partners, to strengthen deterrence to safeguard peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific region. The United States congratulated the Philippines on a successful ASEAN chair year, as the two countries mark 80 years of diplomatic relations. Promoting Peace and Strengthening a Free and Open Indo-Pacific Reflecting President Trump’s commitment to peace through strength, the United States will continue to lead in the Indo-Pacific and deter any nation in the region tempted to settle disputes by force. The United States will continue to uphold the right of all nations under international law as reflected in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Seas (UNCLOS) to exercise freedom of navigation and overflight, including in the South China Sea. Peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait remain essential to the security and prosperity of the Indo-Pacific and the United States opposes any unilateral change to the status quo. The United States remains committed to the complete denuclearization of the DPRK and the full implementation of all DPRK-related UN Security Council resolutions. Expanding Trade, Energy, and Technology Ties The United States remains ASEAN’s largest single country foreign direct investor, with more than $557 billion in foreign direct investment in the region as of 2025, which supports an estimated 532,000 American jobs. The United States congratulated ASEAN leaders for signing the Digital Economy Framework Agreement, which has the potential to provide U.S. technology companies with greater opportunities in the region’s digital economy projected to reach $2 trillion by 2030. As American Super Intelligence (SI) technology sets the gold standard worldwide, the United States is working with Southeast Asian partners to expand access to U.S. technology, including through the U.S.-ASEAN SI SPARK program, which will help unlock the region’s economic potential. By signing the AI Opportunity Statement, Vietnam and Cambodia joined other nations in committing to fostering innovation anchored in trusted partnerships. To support the region’s SI readiness, the United States will collaborate with the Government of Indonesia, ASEAN Secretariat, and Carnegie Mellon University to host ASEAN SI Week in Jakarta in December. The United States and the Philippines signed a five-year Economic Prosperity and Resilience Strategic Objective Agreement, which will mobilize investment in critical infrastructure, including in the Luzon Economic Corridor, and secure supply chains with reliable partners. As one of the world’s largest energy producers, the United States can power Southeast Asia’s growth for generations. The United States is ready to work with ASEAN to strengthen the region’s energy security through support for the ASEAN Power Grid. The United States is sharing its 70 years of experience and leadership in nuclear energy by promoting nuclear safety, security, and nonproliferation in Southeast Asia. Building on our existing 123 Agreements with Indonesia and Vietnam, the United States has entered into 123 Agreements with the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand, and launched negotiations with Malaysia. This cooperation will help the region meet its growing energy demand, including reliable power for SI. The United States is expanding civil nuclear cooperation in Southeast Asia, where energy demand is anticipated to triple by 2050. Consistent with the U.S.-Japan-South Korea Memorandum of Cooperation (MOC) on Small Modular Reactor (SMR) deployments, the United States is providing SMR control room simulators and other technical assistance to Indonesia under the Department’s Foundational Infrastructure for the Responsible Use of Small Modular Reactor Technology (FIRST) program to help establish Indonesia as a regional SMR hub. These partnerships strengthen energy security, drive economic growth, and support jobs in the United States and across the region. Combating Scams and Transnational Crime Scam groups based in Southeast Asia stole at least $18.2 billion from Americans and around $23 billion from citizens of ASEAN member states in 2025. In response, President Trump issued Executive Order 14390, titled “Combating Cybercrime, Fraud, and Predatory Schemes Against American Citizens,” and the Department of State has confronted these criminal groups head on. The Department is directing an additional $26.2 million to train and equip Southeast Asian law enforcement and criminal justice officials to work with U.S. law enforcement to catch and prosecute scam network operators. The United States and 12 regional partners in the Contact Group to Counter Criminal Online Scams agreed to a Statement of Principles to drive joint action to dismantle the scam syndicates targeting our people. The United States and ASEAN also adopted the U.S.-ASEAN Statement on 10 Public-Private Partnership Principles for Tackling Online Scams, deepening regional and private-sector cooperation.

最高法院大法官 15 名法官中，有 9 名裁定该限制符合宪法，其余 6 名则表示该限制违宪或无效。支持这一限制的九名法官中的六名还呼吁日本议会进一步审查该问题，理由是公众辩论不足。
法律不承认被判处监禁或更严厉刑罚且仍在服刑的个人的投票权。
根据下级法院的裁决，原告、40岁的八木桥健太郎在2019年因欺诈罪被判处七年有期徒刑。由于法律原因，他无法在2021年众议院选举和其他民意调查中投票。
他随后提起诉讼，寻求确认自己的投票权以及国家赔偿。东京地方法院于 2023 年驳回了他的主张，认为投票限制符合宪法。东京高等法院维持了2024年的裁决，最高法院周三也得出了相同的结论。

Top court rules prisoner voting restriction constitutional
The law does not recognize the right to vote for individuals sentenced to imprisonment or a more severe penalty and still serving their sentences. | Getty Images
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The Supreme Court on Wednesday ruled that the provision of the public offices election law denying voting rights to prisoners is constitutional, its first judgment on the matter.
The top court ruled that the restriction cannot be said to be unconstitutional at this stage.
Nine of the 15 justices of the court’s Grand Bench ruled the restriction constitutional, while the remaining six said it was unconstitutional or invalid. Six of the nine justices who upheld the restriction also called on the Diet, Japan’s parliament, to examine the issue further, citing insufficient public debate.
The law does not recognize the right to vote for individuals sentenced to imprisonment or a more severe penalty and still serving their sentences.
According to lower court rulings, the plaintiff, Kentaro Yagihashi, 40, was sentenced to seven years in prison for fraud in 2019. Due to the law, he was unable to vote in the 2021 House of Representatives election and other polls.
He subsequently filed a lawsuit seeking confirmation of his right to vote, as well as state compensation. Tokyo District Court dismissed his claims in 2023, finding the voting restriction to be constitutional. Tokyo High Court upheld the ruling in 2024, and the Supreme Court reached the same conclusion on Wednesday.

zh_title: 面对新的人工智能 GPU 租赁和出口限制，中国威胁采取“反制措施”
summary: 昨天，特朗普政府扩大了对高端人工智能加速器芯片（即但不限于英伟达 Blackwell 系列）的现有出口管制范围。更新后的规定现在要求获得许可证才能将这些芯片大量出租给美国的整个 D:5 国家名单（禁止武器销售的国家）。不出所料，这一消息像一条龙一样登陆北京，商务部表示，中方“将采取反制措施，坚定维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。与 TH Premium 一起深入了解：台湾，t
content:
昨天，特朗普政府扩大了对高端人工智能加速器芯片（即但不限于英伟达 Blackwell 系列）的现有出口管制范围。更新后的规定现在要求获得许可证才能将这些芯片大量出租给美国的整个 D:5 国家名单（禁止武器销售的国家）。不出所料，这一消息像一条龙一样登陆北京，商务部表示，中方“将采取反制措施，坚定维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：台积电） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体发展状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审视了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释 美国采取的大胆举措这是一个特殊的时刻，因为特朗普总统目前正在中国访问深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会。特朗普定于 11 月 19 日星期四会见中国国家主席习近平，这次会面一定会很有趣。两国最近都卷入了一场激烈的贸易战，双方的关税和限制不断增加，直到 2025 年 10 月临时休战。
不过，只取消了一些限制；例如，中国半导体在进口到美国时仍面临50%的关税。如果重新启动关税措施，美国股市将出现更严重的动荡。由于英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋与所谓的中国间谍黄爱丽的浪漫关系，这片海域已经波涛汹涌——人们越来越怀疑这对灵魂伴侣可能共谋从她的新加坡公司 Megaspeed 窃取价值数十亿美元的 Blackwell 芯片到中国人工智能实验室。去年 7 月，英伟达切断了大约一半的亚洲买家，似乎是在出口管制的范围内，并告诉数据中心运营商，他们 50% 以上的业务必须来自非中国公司。与此同时，马来西亚和新加坡都加强了对人工智能硬件出货量的审查。中国的反制弹药目前还不清楚。中国此前曾限制向美国出售镓、锗和锑，而休战协议将该协议搁置到 2027 年 11 月。当这一天到来时，北京很可能选择不再续签该协议。尽管分析人士认为，各国在这次峰会上将表现得足够友好，但特朗普的挑衅行为可能会让中国众所周知的限制稀土出口的核选择重新回到装货区。关于这一特定问题的休战协议只剩下几周时间，将于 2027 年 1 月 10 日到期。
同样，对最新一代电动汽车、太阳能存储和电池安装至关重要的超硬材料和高密度锂电池都将在明年初被取消。分析人士还预计，中国企业及其政府将继续大力投资国内芯片生产，即但不仅限于华为。从广义上讲，美国”更新的芯片控制法规意味着中国企业无法通过租赁芯片来规避现有的芯片销售控制，从而弥补了出口限制方面现有的主要漏洞之一。此外，还向印度尼西亚、马来西亚出售芯片

【原文 English Original】
Yesterday, the Trump administration extended the reach of its existing export controls on high-end AI accelerator chips, namely, but not limited to, Nvidia's Blackwell lineup. The updated regulation now requires licenses for renting those chips in large quantities to the entirety of America's D:5 countries list (nations embargoed from arms sales). As expected, the news landed in Beijing like a lead dragon, and its Ministry of Commerce states that China "will take countermeasures to firmly safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests." Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained The bold move taken by the U.S. arrives at a peculiar time, as President Trump is currently visiting the nation for the APEC summit in Shenzhen. Trump is scheduled to meet President Xi Jinping on Thursday, Nov. 19, a tête-a-tête that's bound to be interesting. Both nations were recently embroiled in a bitter trade war, with ever-mounting tariffs and restrictions on both sides until a temporary truce was called in Oct. 2025. Only some restrictions were lifted, though; for example, Chinese semiconductors still face a 50% tariff when imported stateside. A potential restart of tariff-slapping would all but guarantee an even larger amount of turmoil in U.S. stock markets. Those seas are already choppy enough thanks to Nvidia ex-CEO Jensen Huang's romantic involvement with purported Chinese spy Alice Huang — along with mounting suspicions that the soulmates may have connived to siphon billions' worth of Blackwell chips from her Singaporean outfit Megaspeed onto Chinese AI laboratories. Nvidia cut off about half of its Asian buyers last July, seemingly in the purview of the export controls, and told data center operators that over 50% of their business must come from non-Chinese companies. Meanwhile, both Malaysia and Singapore have intensified their scrutiny of AI hardware shipments. China's countermeasures ammo is as of yet unspecified. The nation had restricted the sale of gallium, germanium, and antimony to the U.S. previously, and the truce shelved that bullet until Nov. 2027. Beijing may well choose to simply not renew that agreement when that day comes. Although analysts believe that the nations will be cordial enough during this summit, Trump's perceived provocation may bring China's proverbial nuclear option of restricting rare earth exports back to the loading bay. The truce on that particular matter only has a few weeks left, expiring on Jan. 10, 2027. Likewise, super-hard materials and high-density lithium batteries, crucial for the newest generations of EVs, solar power storage, and battery installations, all have white flags that will come down early next year. Analysts also expect that Chinese firms and their government will continue to heavily invest in domestic chip production, namely, but not only, by Huawei. Broadly speaking, the U.S.' updated chip control regulation means that Chinese firms cannot sidestep the existing control on chip sales by renting them instead, closing one of the main existing loopholes around the export restrictions. Additionally, selling chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, or Brazil now also requires a license, as the U.S. Department of Commerce suspects that companies in these nations import Blackwell cards to sell to China.

content:
特朗普与习近平和普京的历史性会晤成为亚洲之行的头条新闻海峡时报
特朗普与习近平和普京的历史性会晤成为亚洲之行的头条新闻
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
发表于 2026 年 11 月 19 日 07:05
更新于 2026 年 11 月 19 日 07:25
中国深圳11月19日 - 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将于周四与中国和俄罗斯总统习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京举行史无前例的会晤，以此结束他的亚洲之行，尽管北京方面拒绝将这一问题作为会议的核心议题，但他强调了他的核军控野心。
分析人士表示，三边会议将汇集世界三大核大国的领导人，举行一次不寻常的外交聚会，这可能会展示他们的影响力，但不太可能达成重大协议。
在周三的讲话中，习近平呼吁“自由开放的贸易”，将北京描绘成全球舞台上的稳定伙伴，并与特朗普领导下提高关税并采取更强硬外交政策的美国形成鲜明对比。
后来他在深圳机场迎接特朗普，这是中国领导人的一个不同寻常的举动，但也是对美国总统九月在安德鲁斯联合基地与特朗普上次会面时所提供的礼节的回应。两国领导人还交换了短暂的拥抱。
特朗普和普京上次于 2025 年在阿拉斯加会面，进行会谈，但未能结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。两人在深圳拍照时短暂握手并说了几句话，两人分别站在习近平的两侧。俄罗斯国际文传电讯社称，特朗普和普京没有进行实质性对话。
尽管中国一再反对与拥有更大核武库的华盛顿和莫斯科进行谈判，但特朗普坚持将核军控作为三边会议的核心议题。这种分歧可能会使习近平主持的会议变得复杂，但会议在一定程度上是由特朗普的要求决定的。
特朗普将在三边会议之前与习近平举行双边会议并共进工作午餐，美国和俄罗斯官员表示，他还将与普京进行一对一会晤。俄罗斯官员表示，这次会议没有计划进行全面的双边谈判。
特朗普的特使加大了外交努力，以结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争，欧洲领导人也将参与讨论，重点关注战后安全保障和经济复苏规划。
特朗普的亚洲之行提供了一个展示美国影响力、加强与地区盟友关系以及寻求与习近平和普京进行高调外交开放的机会。
但美国总统回国后将面临政治和政策挑战，包括中期选举的影响、英伟达芯片争议以及一系列备受瞩目的技术和航空旅行中断，这些都让美国人感到不安。
保卫民主基金会的克雷格·辛格尔顿表示，三位领导人有充分理由齐聚一堂，但鉴于他们在乌克兰、伊朗、核武器、贸易和中国军力建设方面存在分歧，在实质内容上达成一致的理由要少得多。
辛格尔顿说：“一张照片可以让三个人都受益匪浅。”他补充说，他认为“议程更难达成一致”。
白宫官员表示，预计特朗普不会在三边会议期间提出乌克兰战争问题。然而，特朗普表示他可以提出这个问题，这给领导人之间的冲突是否会进入讨论留下了一些不确定性。
此次聚会也正值盛大的

Trump's historic meeting with Xi, Putin headlines Asia trip | The Straits Times
Trump's historic meeting with Xi, Putin headlines Asia trip
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Published Nov 19, 2026, 07:05 AM
Updated Nov 19, 2026, 07:25 AM
SHENZHEN, China, Nov 19 - US President Donald Trump will cap his Asia trip on Thursday with an unprecedented meeting with Chinese and Russian counterparts Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, pressing his ambitions for nuclear arms control even as Beijing resists making the issue a centerpiece of the gathering.
The trilateral meeting will bring together the leaders of the world's three largest nuclear powers for an unusual diplomatic gathering that could showcase their influence but is unlikely to produce major agreements, analysts say.
In a speech on Wednesday, Xi called for "free and open trade," portraying Beijing as a stable partner on the global stage, and drawing a contrast with the US, which has raised tariffs and adopted a more muscular foreign policy under Trump.
He later greeted Trump at the airport in Shenzhen, an unusual gesture by the Chinese leader, but one that reciprocated formalities extended by the US president at Joint Base Andrews in September when they last met. The leaders also exchanged a brief hug.
Trump and Putin, who last met in Alaska in 2025 for talks that failed to end Russia's war in Ukraine, shared a brief handshake and a few words at a photo opportunity in Shenzhen, where they were placed on either side of Xi. Russia's Interfax news agency said Trump and Putin did not have a substantive conversation.
Trump has insisted nuclear arms control be a central topic of the trilateral, despite China's repeated objections to joining negotiations with Washington and Moscow, which possess far larger nuclear arsenals. The disagreement threatens to complicate a meeting hosted by Xi but shaped in part by Trump's demands.
Trump is to have a bilateral meeting and a working lunch with Xi ahead of the trilateral, and US and Russian officials said he would also have a one-on-one meeting with Putin. The Russian officials said no full-scale bilateral negotiations were planned at that meeting.
Trump's envoys have intensified diplomatic efforts to end Russia's war in Ukraine, with discussions that are also set to involve European leaders focused on postwar security guarantees and economic recovery planning.
Trump's Asia trip has offered a chance to showcase US influence, strengthen ties with regional allies and pursue a high-profile diplomatic opening with Xi and Putin.
But the US president will return home facing political and policy challenges, including the fallout from bruising midterm elections, the Nvidia chip controversy and a spate of high-profile technology and air travel outages that have rattled Americans.
Craig Singleton of the Foundation for Defense of Democracies said the three leaders have plenty of reasons to appear together but far fewer to agree on substance, given their differences over Ukraine, Iran, nuclear weapons, trade and China's military buildup.
"A photograph could serve all three men well," Singleton said, adding that he thought the "agenda is much harder to agree on."
White House officials have said Trump is not expected to raise the war in Ukraine during the trilateral. Trump, however, has suggested he could bring it up, leaving some uncertainty about whether the conflict will enter discussions among the leaders.
The gathering also comes amid growing tensions over reports of Nvidia chips being diverted to China through Southeast Asia, raising questions about the effectiveness of US export restrictions and the future of Chinese access to advanced technology.
"This is Beijing's worst nightmare. China wants chip access that it can negotiate with the president. It may get chip restrictions written into law by both parties," Singleton said.
Trump's bilateral meeting with Xi on Thursday will also provide an opportunity to assess the durability of a trade truce reached earlier this month.
The president has also expressed interest in meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, but US officials have repeatedly said no such encounter is planned during this trip.
Randy Schriver, a former senior Pentagon official in Trump's first administration, said the president would relish such a meeting.
"I think President Trump would meet with Kim Jong Un tomorrow if he could ... he likes the theater, the political theater, the spectacle of it," Schriver said.
Following the trilateral, Trump is scheduled to depart Shenzhen for Washington, concluding a trip that has included regional security and trade engagements in the Philippines and China. REUTERS

summary: 美国空军正在加强在该国最西端岛屿的训练，寻求开发更多的地方来投射力量并监视太平洋和北极的对手。这些努力在十月下旬就可见一斑，当时空军部署到阿拉斯加阿留申群岛的谢米亚岛进行一次罕见的演习，空军发布了一份概述其在关岛附近岛屿行动计划的提案。在比阿拉斯加大陆更靠近俄罗斯的谢米亚，10 月 18 日至 26 日期间，F-16、加油机和货机部署到埃尔克森机场。
content:
美国空军正在加强在该国最西端岛屿的训练，寻求开发更多的地方来投射力量并监视太平洋和北极的对手。这些努力在十月下旬就可见一斑，当时空军部署到阿拉斯加阿留申群岛的谢米亚岛进行一次罕见的演习，空军发布了一份概述其在关岛附近岛屿行动计划的提案。谢米亚距离俄罗斯比阿拉斯加大陆更近，10 月 18 日至 26 日期间，F-16、加油机和货机部署到厄里克森机场。在那里，这些喷气式飞机“保持警惕”，机组人员就位，随时准备在接到通知后立即起飞。阿拉斯加 NORAD 地区发言人 Kitsana Dounglomchan 上尉在一封电子邮件中表示：“虽然飞机在 20 世纪 80 年代处于警戒状态是很常见的事情，但这次部署标志着数十年来飞机在厄尔克森首次处于警戒状态。”作为美国-加拿大国土防御演习的一部分，谢米亚部署以远程行动结束。当 F-16 战机从厄尔克森起飞，覆盖阿拉斯加战区南部时，位于西边 1,600 英里的艾尔森空军基地的 F-35 和 F-16 战机也起飞，覆盖战区西北部。加拿大 CF-18 飞机从距谢米亚 2,600 英里的冷湖基地起飞，覆盖北部地区。
阿拉斯加北美防空司令部司令、空军中将罗伯特·戴维斯在一份新闻稿中表示，从厄尔克森出发的行动“证明我们可以部署到严峻的地点，保持警戒，在短时间内发射，并无缝整合美国和加拿大军队以保卫北方通道”。自二战以来，美国军方一直在谢米亚地区活跃。冷战期间，该基地驻有加油机和侦察机以及雷达，以监视苏联的活动，特别是苏联的洲际弹道导弹。大型 Cobra Dane 雷达建于 20 世纪 70 年代，至今仍用于监测导弹活动。最近在谢米亚的部署突显了其作为阿留申群岛栖息地的持续重要性，阿留申群岛横跨连接太平洋和北极的战略重要水域。 2024 年 9 月，美国士兵使用 HIMARS 发射器进行了一次“兵力投送行动”，此前俄罗斯和中国在该地区进行了一系列活动，其中包括中俄轰炸机在阿拉斯加附近进行的首次巡逻。最近的其他演习似乎侧重于保护该岛的基础设施免受海上入侵和空袭。据一份新闻稿称，在厄里克森期间，飞行员还认证了该基地的飞机拦截系统，可以处理 F-16 战斗机，“进一步验证了厄里克森机场作为未来战斗机在严峻机场执行任务的可行地点”。
Dounglomchan拒绝就厄尔克森的未来行动发表评论，但表示北美防空司令部保持着“作战能力”，可以“在我们选择的时间和地点”在阿拉斯加和北极周围调动部队，并且“经常到厄尔克森这样的偏远地区”。随着谢米亚演习的结束，空军分享了未来在太平洋中部岛屿上的行动计划。 在 10 月底发布的一份提案中，空军表示将研究每年在北马里亚纳群岛联邦罗塔岛、塞班岛和天宁岛的机场进行多达 1,500 次甚至可能超过 1,800 次飞机行动（例如起飞和降落）的影响。这些作业将是小型、中型和大型演习的一部分

【原文 English Original】
The U.S. Air Force is stepping up its training on the country’s westernmost islands as it seeks to develop more places from which to project power and monitor adversaries across the Pacific and the Arctic. Those efforts were visible in late October, when airmen deployed to Shemya Island in Alaska’s Aleutian Islands for a rare exercise, and when the Air Force released a proposal outlining its plans for operations on islands near Guam. On Shemya, which is closer to Russia than to mainland Alaska , F-16s, tankers and cargo planes deployed to Eareckson Air Station from Oct. 18 to Oct. 26. While there, the jets “sat alert,” with crews in position and maintaining readiness to launch on short notice. “While it was commonplace for aircraft to sit alert in the 1980s, this deployment marks the first time in decades that aircraft have sat alert at Eareckson,” Capt. Kitsana Dounglomchan, Alaskan NORAD Region spokesperson, said in an email. The Shemya deployment ended with long-range operations as part of a U.S.-Canada homeland-defense exercise. As F-16s launched from Eareckson to cover the southern portion of the Alaska theater of operations, F-35s and F-16s at Eielson Air Force Base 1,600 miles to the west took off to cover the northwest portion of the theater. Canadian CF-18s flew from their base at Cold Lake, 2,600 miles from Shemya, to cover the northern part. Operating from Eareckson “proved we can deploy to an austere location, maintain alert, launch on short notice, and seamlessly integrate U.S. and Canadian forces to defend the northern approaches,” Air Force Lt. Gen. Robert Davis, commander of the Alaskan NORAD region, said in a press release. The U.S. military has been active on Shemya since World War II. During the Cold War, the base hosted refueling and surveillance aircraft as well as radars to monitor Soviet activity, especially Soviet ICBMs. The massive Cobra Dane radar was built there in the 1970s and is still used to monitor missile activity. Recent deployments to Shemya underscore its continued relevance as a perch in the Aleutians, which stretch across strategically important waters linking the Pacific and Arctic. A “ force projection operation ” by U.S. soldiers with HIMARS launchers in September 2024 came after a flurry of Russian and Chinese activity in the area, including the first Sino-Russian bomber patrol near Alaska. Other recent exercises appear to have focused on defending the island’s infrastructure from seaborne incursions and aerial attacks. While at Eareckson, airmen also certified the base’s aircraft-arresting system to handle F-16s, “further validating Eareckson Air Station as a viable location for future fighter operations from an austere airfield,” according to a press release. Dounglomchan declined to comment on future operations at Eareckson but said NORAD maintains “the operational capability” to move forces around Alaska and the Arctic “at a time and place of our choosing” and “oftentimes to remote locations like Eareckson.” As the drills on Shemya wrapped up, the Air Force shared its plans for future operations on islands in the central Pacific. In a proposal released at the end of October, the service said it would study the impact of conducting up to 1,500 and potentially more than 1,800 aircraft operations, such as takeoffs and landings, annually at airfields on Rota, Saipan, and Tinian in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands. The operations would be part of small, medium and large drills held several times a year for a few weeks at a time. They would also involve deployment of up to 550,000 gallons of fuel and up to 1,000 personnel at each airfield, as well as munitions, temporary infrastructure, and support operations. The Air Force said its study would assess “the potential social, economic, and environmental effects” of those operations. HC-130J Combat King II pilots assigned to the 211th Rescue Squadron pilot an aircraft en route from Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson to Eareckson Air Station, Alaska, on Oct. 19, 2026. (Airman 1st Class Frank Houseton/U.S. Air Force) The study won’t be completed until mid-2028, but the proposal highlights the Air Force’s recent focus on those islands, especially Tinian, where airmen are refurbishing North Field , one of the U.S.’s largest and most important WWII airbases. North Field was abandoned and overgrown after the war, but airmen have been clearing vegetation, removing debris and rehabilitating runways since late 2023. That work is ongoing but had progressed enough by mid-2025 for North Field to be deemed “a semi-permanent [contingency] location” for the Air Force’s main base on Guam, about 100 miles to the south. The Northern Marianas is a U.S. territory in the Second Island Chain, which stretches from Japan through the central Pacific to Indonesia. The Air Force has been scouting airfields in that island chain and conducting renovations and upgrades to make them better able to support its Agile Combat Employment concept, which emphasizes dispersal and resilience to counter the threat from China. “China’s missile force is large, but it’s not unlimited. Every additional airfield from where the Air Force can operate is another of targets China has to cover. That’s the logic behind Agile Combat Employment,” said Kelly Greico, a senior fellow at the Stimson Center. Improvements on Shemya and in the Northern Marianas enhance the Air Force’s ability to operate in those places, but those operations are influenced by the islands’ locations, according to Greico, whose research focuses on airpower strategy. Shemya “is primarily about homeland defense. Its location in the North Pacific makes it useful mainly as a forward operating location for NORAD,” Greico said. “The value of the remote airfield lies less in its ability to generate sorties under contested conditions than in its geographic position in intercepting Russian aircraft forward.” But investments in Rota, Tinian, and Saipan, Greico added, “are primarily about expanding the number of locations from which the Air Force could operate, reducing its dependence on Andersen Air Base at Guam.” Both Shemya and the Northern Marianas provide the benefit of being U.S. territory, giving the Pentagon greater freedom to operate. Bases in the Philippines and Japan are closer to China, but those countries have more control over what U.S. forces do at their facilities and may limit their access and operations during a crisis or conflict. Geography tempers those political benefits, however. In the Stimson Center’s modeling , dispersal had “the biggest effect of any countermeasure we tested,” Greico said. “But the effect is much smaller in the Second Island Chain than in Japan, because there just aren’t many runways out there.” “Chinese missile strikes could keep U.S. runways in Guam and other Pacific islands closed to tankers and bombers for about four days. Adding civilian airfields in Guam, the Northern Marianas, and Palau only reduced those times by a matter of hours,” Greico added. “Geography matters here. There’s a lot of water out there, but not much land.”

title: Destroyer returns from 11-month-deployment
zh_title: 驱逐舰结束 11 个月的部署返回
summary: 夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。斯普鲁亚
content:
夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。另一艘阿利伯克级驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号在经过 12 个月的部署后于今天返回家园，驻日本的约翰·芬恩号船员被告知预计将进行 13 至 14 个月的部署。正如《防务一号》10 月 22 日报道的那样，海军官员告诉家属，在可预见的未来，部署时间预计为 10 到 10 个月，这与近几十年来典型的 7 个月部署形成鲜明对比。海军最高军士长、海军军士长约翰·佩里曼 (John Perryman) 一周后证实了这一点，并表示至少在未来几年内，10 至 11 个月将成为常态。迈克尔·墨菲号中校表示，“迈克尔·墨菲”号于 2025 年 12 月 1 日离开夏威夷，穿过南中国海和马六甲海峡，然后到达北阿拉伯海，并在那里度过了大部分部署时间。大卫·尼古拉斯一个月前接任这艘驱逐舰的指挥。
尼古拉斯说，“迈克尔·墨菲”号在“史诗狂怒”行动期间发动了“战斧”导弹袭击，并参与了霍尔木兹海峡的封锁。“我非常自豪能够成为这个团队的一员，”他说。 “这是我有幸共事过的最有韧性的团队。”尼古拉斯此前指挥过另一艘导弹驱逐舰奥斯卡·奥斯汀号。据海军新闻稿称，当他于 9 月 10 日将掌权交给继任者时，他将成为罗德岛州水面作战学校的教官。但一名海军官员向《防务一号》证实，当“迈克尔·墨菲”号的前任上司中校改变了他的计划。凯特琳·坎宁安 (Caitlin Cunningham) 在执掌约 11 个月后，因“失去信心”而于 9 月 27 日被解职。在周四的返校节上，三等士官杰西·布莱森第一个下船，成为“初吻”抽奖的获胜者。他和妻子阿里安娜·里奥斯站在一起，开玩笑说这次部署涉及“大量的水”。 “加入海军，看看世界——但世界 70% 都是水，”他笑着说。但是，他补充说，工作人员很棒。 “我认为你可以把这艘船上的任何人放在任何其他船上，他们都会脱颖而出，”布莱森说。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
PEARL HARBOR, Hawaii —After a 346-day deployment that included operations in the South China Sea, 12 contested transits of the Strait of Hormuz, 43 replenishments at sea and the removal of its commander 10 months in, the guided-missile-destroyer Michael Murphy returned home Thursday, welcomed by hula dancers and a rainbow stretching over the channel. The ship was attached to the Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group for much of its deployment, though the aircraft carrier returned to its home in San Diego on Oct. 8. But any deployment-length records it may have broken were short lived. The Spruance, another Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, returned home today after a 12-month deployment, and the Japan-based John Finn crew has been told to expect a 13- to 14-month deployment. As Defense One reported on Oct. 22, Navy officials have told families to expect 10- to 10-month deployments for the foreseeable future—a stark contrast from the typical 7-month deployments of recent decades. The Navy’s top enlisted sailor, Master Chief Petty Officer of the Navy John Perryman, confirmed that a week later, saying 10-11 months will be the norm for at least a few years. The Micheal Murphy left Hawaii on Dec. 1, 2025, and sailed through the South China Sea and Strait of Malacca before reaching the North Arabian Sea, where it spent the bulk of the deployment, said Cmdr. David Nicolas, who took command of the destroyer a month ago. The Michael Murphy launched Tomahawk missile strikes during Operation Epic Fury and took part in the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Nicolas said. “I’m incredibly proud to be part of this team,” he said. “This is the most resilient crew that I’ve had the pleasure to serve with.” Nicolas previously commanded the Oscar Austin, another guided-missile destroyer. When he handed over the helm to his successor on Sept. 10, he was slated to become an instructor at Surface Warfare Schools in Rhode Island, according to a Navy press release . But a Navy official confirmed to Defense One that his plans were changed when the Michael Murphy’s previous boss, Cmdr. Caitlin Cunningham, was relieved on Sept. 27 due to a “loss of confidence” after roughly 11 months in charge.    At Thursday’s homecoming, Petty Officer 3rd Class Jesse Bryson was first off the ship, as the winner of the “first kiss” raffle. Standing with his wife, Arianna Rios, he joked that the deployment involved “a lot of water.” “Join the Navy, see the world—but the world is 70-percent water,” he said with a laugh. But, he added, the crew was great. “I think you could put anyone from this ship on any other ship and they’d stand out,” Bryson said. ]]>

通过增加菲律宾进口美国能源和农产品来减少对菲律宾的贸易逆差，这将为数以万计的美国工程师、技术人员和农民提供就业机会。波音公司和通用电气航空航天公司最终以 120 亿美元的价格向菲律宾航空公司出售多达 20 架配备通用电气航空航天发动机的波音 787 飞机，为美国提供 47,000 个就业岗位。美国和菲律宾将寻求历史性的超过20亿美元的对外军事融资（FMF）贷款计划，为菲律宾提供来自美国供应商的关键国防和安全能力，支持7000多个美国就业岗位，推进总统的国家安全战略和美国第一武器转让战略，同时保护美国纳税人的回报。特朗普总统的“美国优先”武器转让战略确保盟国支出的激增有利于美国国防工业，实现美国再工业化并支持美国就业，同时为我们的合作伙伴提供世界上最好的能力。美国将利用 4 亿美元的 FMF 帮助菲律宾军队扩大其在南海的作战范围和威慑能力，包括远程火力、指挥和控制、关键基础设施和多域无人机，支持 1,500 个美国就业岗位。美国和菲律宾同意合作，向菲律宾的主权云基础设施提供值得信赖的美国公司。

Trump concluded a two-day visit to the Philippines for a State Visit and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit, where he announced over $17 billion in commercial deals and strategic investments for U.S. companies that will support tens of thousands of American jobs, bolster regional security that protects the United States from illicit activity, and support a free and open Indo-Pacific that economically benefits American companies, workers, and consumers. SECURING HISTORIC DEALS WITH THE PHILIPPINES: President Ferdinand R. Marcos, Jr. hosted President Trump for a historic State Visit in Manila, where the two leaders announced landmark deals that will strengthen the U.S.-Philippine Alliance and support American companies and workers. The leaders also committed to eliminate the U.S. trade deficit with the Philippines through increased Philippine imports of American energy and agriculture products, which will support the jobs of tens of thousands of American engineers, technicians, and farmers. U.S. companies Boeing and GE Aerospace finalized a $12 billion sale to Philippine Airlines for up to 20 Boeing 787 aircrafts with GE Aerospace engines, supporting 47,000 U.S. jobs. The United States and the Philippines will pursue a historic Foreign Military Financing (FMF) loan package of more than $2 billion to provide the Philippines with critical defense and security capabilities from U.S. suppliers, supporting over 7,000 American jobs and advancing the President’s National Security Strategy and America First Arms Transfer Strategy, all while protecting returns for the American taxpayer. President Trump’s America First Arms Transfer Strategy ensures that the surge in allies’ spending benefits the U.S. defense industry, reindustrializing America and supporting American jobs while arming our partners with the best capabilities in the world. The United States will utilize $400 million in FMF for the Philippine military to expand its operational reach and deterrence capabilities in the South China Sea, including long-range fires, command and control, critical infrastructure, and multi-domain drones, supporting 1,500 American jobs. The United States and the Philippines agreed to partner on supply the Philippines’ sovereign cloud infrastructure with trusted U.S. Super Intelligence technology through the United States’ SI Exports Program. The Philippine Department of National Defense (DND) announced a $37 million contract with a U.S. firm, supporting 140 American jobs. The contract delivers SI-enabled mission support, expands U.S.-Philippine defense cooperation, and improves interoperability. The Philippine DND committed to work with trusted U.S. technology providers on a $63 million initiative to modernize its defense cloud infrastructure for SI use cases, supporting over 200 American jobs. The United States and the Philippines committed to improving cooperation in critical technologies. The United States and the Philippines announced exploration of an intergovernmental agreement on civil-nuclear technology which would open opportunities for U.S. nuclear companies, support American jobs, and generate gigawatts of energy for the Philippines. This marks the first U.S. civil-nuclear intergovernmental agreement with an Indo-Pacific partner. U.S. company Astranis announced it is offering connectivity services from its U.S.-manufactured AGILA satellite to the Philippines, a commercial opportunity worth up to $200 million, supporting 600 American jobs, to provide independent and secure communications infrastructure for the Philippine government and people. President Trump is leveraging strategic infrastructure to strengthen the U.S.-Philippine Alliance, secure critical supply chains, open new markets for American businesses, and support American workers. Subic Grain will build a new $40 million fuel storage depot at Subic Bay to support U.S. military and commercial operations. The United States and the Philippines announced that the Philippines will modernize its Basco Airport to improve U.S.-Philippine operational access, disaster response, and commercial supply chains in the Philippines’ northernmost islands. FINALIZING THE U.S.-THAILAND TRADE DEAL AND INCREASING MILITARY SALES:   At the ASEAN Summit, President Trump announced the substantial conclusion of a trade deal and a weapons sale with Thailand that will give American workers, manufacturers, farmers, ranchers, and businesses unprecedented access to Thailand’s market.   The trade deal, once signed, will eliminate tariffs on 99 percent of goods and remove non-tariff barriers on American vehicles, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, ethanol, and poultry, increasing market access for a full range of U.S. industrial and agricultural exports. The trade deal will also protect and enforce U.S. intellectual property, increase economic security alignment, and strengthen and enforce Thai labor and environmental laws to balance trade. Separately, Thailand intends to commit up to $123 million toward the purchase of America’s High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS). The sale would give America’s treaty Ally long-range precision fires and support 400 American jobs and the U.S. defense industrial base. Once concluded, it would be the first deal of its kind in mainland Southeast Asia. SECURING INVESTMENT DEALS ACROSS SOUTHEAST ASIA:   President Trump opened new markets for American goods and created opportunities for U.S. companies, furthering U.S. leadership in digital connectivity across the region. In Indonesia, U.S. company Latitude Energy and Indonesian sovereign wealth fund Danantara announced negotiations on a $2 billion project that will use world-class U.S. technology to improve Indonesia’s utilization of its coal resources. Panasonic signed a multi-year agreement to buy advanced silicon-carbon anode materials from U.S. company Sila. The agreement is worth up to $1 billion and will support an additional 500 American jobs. In Malaysia, Navajo Transitional Energy Company (NTEC) signed a three-year $100 million agreement to supply coal from its southern Montana mine to TNB Fuel Services, the fuel procurement subsidiary of Malaysia’s national power utility, Tenaga Nasional Berhad. LEADING THE REGION IN SUPER INTELLIGENCE: In addition to Philippine commitments on American SI technology above, President Trump announced further deployment of American SI technology across the region through our SI Exports Program, cementing U.S. firms and American technology as the global standard for trusted partners. President Trump and Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar announced that a U.S. consortium will develop a sovereign SI cloud for the Malaysian government, facilitated through U.S.-ASEAN SI SPARK. Brunei’s Unified National Networks intends to award U.S. company Vertiv the Rimba Data Centre tender and source the nearly $1 billion buildout from U.S. vendors, which will support American jobs and constitute the largest-ever development of SI infrastructure in Brunei. content:
习近平在APEC峰会上与高一握手海峡时报
中国习近平与高市握手，关系仍然紧张
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
11月18日，国家主席习近平在深圳出席亚太经合组织峰会嘉宾欢迎宴会上会见日本首相高市早苗。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 18 日晚上 10:05
更新于 2026 年 11 月 18 日晚上 10:35
习近平在深圳举行的亚太经合组织宴会上与日本首相高市早苗握手，这是自日本首相高市早苗因台湾言论导致两国关系恶化以来的首次正式接触。
日本曾寻求保证习近平不会冷落高市，但她在机场受到的欢迎规模比韩国领导人要小，而且迎接她的是一位前官员。
高一表示台湾的袭击可能威胁日本的生存后，中国和日本的关系仍然紧张。中国要求撤回并实施稀土出口限制。
深圳 — 11 月 18 日，中国国家主席习近平与来访的日本首相高市早苗握手，这是自 2025 年末高市发表涉台言论导致双边关系恶化以来两国领导人的首次正式互动。
此次会面正值习近平和夫人彭丽媛在深圳为出席亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议的客人举行的欢迎宴会上接待客人。高一与习近平握手并交谈。高一随后与彭一一握手。
习近平还向其他领导人致意并合影留念。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京站在习近平和彭丽媛的左边，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普紧邻他们的右边。高市位于后排，距离中间好几个位置。
彭博新闻社 11 月初报道称，日本官员已向中国寻求保证，表示习近平将在峰会上给予高市与其他世界领导人相同的待遇，并避免日本领导人受到冷落。
尽管在欢迎宴会上有互动，但当高一当天早些时候抵达深圳机场时，接待她的是一位前中国外交部官员，而不是现任官员。与当天早些时候韩国总统李在明的欢迎仪式相比，规模要小得多。
日本外务省新闻秘书北村敏博在会见记者时淡化了高一与习近平握手的重要性，称其为“正常礼节”。
高市于 2025 年 11 月向国会表示，中国对台湾的攻击可能构成威胁日本生存的局面，此后中日关系急剧恶化。尽管东京长期以来一直持有这种观点，但历届首相都避免公开表达这一观点，以防止与北京的关系出现恶化。
中国声称对台湾实行民主治理，是其领土的一部分，对此作出愤怒反应，并要求高市收回言论。她没有这样做。日本坚称与中国沟通的大门仍然敞开，但过去一年东京和北京之间的高层互动很少。
中国对日本实施了一系列政治和经济措施，包括限制对日本汽车和科技行业至关重要的稀土出口。中国还指责高市奉行“新军国主义”，因为她寻求增加对日本防务部门的投资。
11月18日，高市会见中国农业农村部部长

Xi shakes hands with Takaichi at APEC summit | The Straits Times
China’s Xi shakes hands with Takaichi as ties remain strained
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Chinese President Xi Jinping receiving Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi at a welcome banquet for guests attending the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Nov 18.
Published Nov 18, 2026, 10:05 PM
Updated Nov 18, 2026, 10:35 PM
Xi Jinping shook hands with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi at the APEC banquet in Shenzhen, their first official contact since ties worsened over her Taiwan comments.
Japan had sought reassurance that Xi would not snub Takaichi, but her airport welcome was smaller than South Korea’s leader and she was met by a former official.
China and Japan remain tense after Takaichi said a Taiwan attack could threaten Japan’s survival. China has demanded a retraction and imposed rare-earth export curbs.
SHENZHEN – Chinese President Xi Jinping shook hands with visiting Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Nov 18, the first official interaction between the two leaders since bilateral ties deteriorated late in 2025 in the wake of comments made by Takaichi about Taiwan.
The encounter came as Xi and his wife, Peng Liyuan, received guests at a welcome banquet for guests attending the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders’ meeting in Shenzhen. Takaichi shook hands with Xi, after which they exchanged a few words. Takaichi then shook hands with Peng.
Xi also greeted other leaders and posed with them for a group photo. Russian President Vladimir Putin stood to the left of Xi and Peng, with US President Donald Trump immediately to their right. Takaichi was several places from the centre in the back row.
Bloomberg News reported earlier in November that Japanese officials had sought reassurances from China that Xi would give Takaichi the same treatment as other world leaders at the summit and avoid a snub of the Japanese leader.
Despite the interaction at the welcome banquet, when Takaichi arrived at Shenzhen airport earlier in the day she was received by a former Chinese Foreign Ministry official rather than a current official. The welcome ceremony was much smaller than that for South Korean President Lee Jae Myung earlier in the day.
At a meeting with journalists, Japanese Foreign Ministry press secretary Toshihiro Kitamura played down the significance of Takaichi’s handshake with Xi, describing it as “normal protocol”.
Relations between China and Japan deteriorated sharply after Takaichi told parliament in November 2025 that a Chinese attack on Taiwan could constitute a situation threatening Japan’s survival. While that has long been the view in Tokyo, previous prime ministers have avoided stating it in public to prevent roiling ties with Beijing.
China, which claims democratically governed Taiwan as part of its territory, reacted angrily and demanded that Takaichi retract the remarks. She has not done so. Japan has insisted that the door to communication with China remains open, but there has been minimal high-level interaction between Tokyo and Beijing in the past year.
China has imposed a series of political and economic measures against Japan, including restrictions on rare-earth exports that are important to the Japanese auto and technology industries. China has also accused Takaichi of “neo-militarism” as she seeks to increase investment in Japan’s defence sector.
On Nov 18, Takaichi greeted Chinese Minister of Agriculture and Rural Affairs Zhang Zhu before they sat down for an ASEAN meeting with China, Japan and South Korea. BLOOMBERG

summary: 国际原子能机构称朝鲜正在扩建宁边铀浓缩工厂《海峡时报》 国际原子能机构称朝鲜正在扩建宁边铀浓缩工厂 立即注册：深入了解亚洲快速发展的发展 卫星图像显示朝鲜宁边一座核材料生产工厂，拍摄于 2026 年 5 月 17 日。发布时间 2026 年 11 月 18 日晚上 09:40 更新时间 2026 年 11 月 18 日晚上 10:57 维也纳 – 朝鲜已联合国核监督机构表示，随着继续扩大武器级材料的生产，在宁边核设施中扩建了原来的铀浓缩工厂
content:
国际原子能机构称朝鲜正在扩建宁边铀浓缩工厂海峡时报
国际原子能机构称朝鲜正在扩建宁边铀浓缩工厂
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
卫星图像显示 2026 年 5 月 17 日朝鲜宁边一座核材料生产工厂。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 18 日，晚上 09:40
更新于 2026 年 11 月 18 日晚上 10:57
维也纳 — — 联合国核监察机构负责人拉斐尔·格罗西 (Rafael Grossi) 11 月 18 日表示，随着朝鲜继续扩大武器级材料的生产，朝鲜已对其宁边核设施的原铀浓缩工厂进行了扩建。
自平壤于 2009 年驱逐核查人员以来，国际原子能机构 (IAEA) 一直无法进入朝鲜。该机构目前主要使用卫星图像来观察该国。
朝鲜，正式名称为朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（DPRK），已经进行了多次核试验，并且似乎继续生产两种可用于制造核武器核心的材料——高浓缩铀和钚。
格罗西在向国际原子能机构 35 国理事会季度会议发表的一份声明中表示：“此前，我已向大家报告了江山和宁边浓缩设施的持续运行情况、宁边增建浓缩设施的情况，以及据报道朝鲜进一步扩大武器级核材料生产的情况。”
康村位于平壤西南部，而宁边更大的遗址距离首都更远。
他表示：“自 2026 年 9 月中旬以来，原宁边浓缩设施的进一步扩建工程一直在建设中，新的扩建工程将于 2026 年 10 月下旬在外部完成。”但他没有详细说明。
“朝鲜不断扩大的铀浓缩计划仍然令人严重担忧，”他补充道。
格罗西表示，国际原子能机构还“观察到迹象”，朝鲜用来从乏燃料生产钚的宁边5兆瓦核反应堆可能仍在继续运行，并处于第七个辐照周期，之后乏燃料将被移走进行后处理。
他补充说，宁边的另一个轻水反应堆自四月份以来一直在运行。路透社

IAEA says North Korea is expanding uranium-enrichment plant at Yongbyon
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
A satellite image showing a nuclear material production factory in Yongbyon, North Korea, on May 17, 2026.
Published Nov 18, 2026, 09:40 PM
Updated Nov 18, 2026, 10:57 PM
VIENNA – North Korea has built an extension to its original uranium-enrichment plant at its Yongbyon nuclear complex as it continues to expand its production of weapons-grade material, UN nuclear watchdog chief Rafael Grossi said on Nov 18.
The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) has not had access to North Korea since Pyongyang expelled its inspectors in 2009. The agency now observes the country using mainly satellite imagery.
North Korea, formally known as the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), has carried out several nuclear tests and appears to continue to produce the two materials with which one can make the core of a nuclear weapon – highly enriched uranium and plutonium.
“Previously, I have reported to you about the ongoing operation of enrichment facilities at Kangson and Yongbyon, the construction of an additional enrichment facility at Yongbyon, and the reported further expansion of the DPRK’s production of weapons-grade nuclear material,” Grossi said in a statement to a quarterly meeting of the IAEA’s 35-nation board of governors.
Kangson is just outside Pyongyang to the south-west, while the much larger site at Yongbyon is further away from the capital to the north.
“Since mid-September 2026, a further extension to the original Yongbyon enrichment facility has been under construction, with the new extension externally complete by late October 2026,” he said, without elaborating.
“The ongoing expansion of the DPRK’s uranium enrichment programme remains a cause for serious concern,” he added.
Grossi said the IAEA has also “observed indications” that the 5-megawatt nuclear reactor at Yongbyon that North Korea uses to produce plutonium from spent fuel probably continues to operate and is in its seventh irradiation cycle, after which the spent fuel would be removed for reprocessing.
Another light-water reactor in Yongbyon has been operating since April, he added. REUTERS

content:
2026年11月18日，在廣東省深圳市舉行的亞太經合組織（APEC）峰會歡迎晚宴前，美國總統川普（左）與俄羅斯總統普京握手。(Lori Sagisawa/POOL/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月19日訊】（大紀元記者張婷綜合報導）美國總統川普（特朗普）週三（11月18日）抵達中國深圳，開啟了他亞洲之行中最關鍵的一環：與中共黨魁習近平及俄羅斯總統普京舉行一場史無前例的三邊峰會。在川普積極斡旋俄烏戰爭和平協議以及普京面臨西方孤立之際，兩人之間的互動倍受國際關注。
路透社報導，世界領導人聚集在一起，握手自是常態，但週三發生的一次握手格外引人注目：普京和川普的握手意味深長。
在參加APEC峰會期間拍集體照時，普京走向川普，距離還有一段就伸出了手，一直走到跟前，兩人熱情握手。川普還拍了拍普京。在俄羅斯因入侵烏克蘭而遭到西方大部分國家孤立的背景下，這一舉動公開展示了兩人之間的親善姿態。（點擊這裡看相關視頻。）
路透社分析認為，這一幕讓普京有機會向外界展示，他仍能與美國總統直接接觸，在國際舞台上仍有一席之地。對川普而言，這一互動則體現出他重視與其他世界領導人建立私人關係。
雖然這次短暫互動不能保證在政策上取得任何突破，但為週四（11月19日）的會晤營造了友好氣氛。屆時，川普、普京和習近平將舉行首次三邊會晤。預計川普還將與普京單獨會面。
川普希望在三邊會晤中討論限制核武器問題。他還表示，烏克蘭和伊朗問題也將被納入討論範疇。
據美國全國廣播公司（NBC）報導，華盛頓智庫保衛民主基金會（Foundation for Defense of Democracies）中國問題專家克雷格‧辛格爾頓（Craig Singleton）表示，川普寄望於憑藉私人關係，將各國領導人召集到一起談論這一問題，這是其他美國總統無法做到的。
川普週二（11月17日）在菲律賓參加東盟—美國特別峰會期間，也強調了建立私人關係的重要性。他當時對在座的東盟國家領導人說，彼此熟識真的會讓事情順利得多。他說，自己幾乎了解在座的所有人，這讓雙方合作起來容易得多，也順暢得多。

content:
Fundraiser by Heather Liu : Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case
Heather Liu is organizing this fundraiser.
What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex forced on me, followed by lies and denial. Then, rare moments of hope, followed by setbacks tinged with revenge from a father whose fear of revealing truth drives him to deny his child’s existence. This child is my daughter. For 20 years I’ve hidden the nightmare involving her origin by my silence, partly due to the sense of shame and partly because the father of my child is a influential public figure. Till the rapist has pushed us to a corner by threatening our existence with vicious conspiracy theories.
（我經歷了任何一位女性都不該經歷的事情。先是遭遇性侵，接著還要面對謊言、抵賴和詆毀。過去20年來，間或閃現的希望，卻因我女兒的生父拒絕承認這孩子的存在，而淹沒在長久的幻滅中。過去20年來，我一直對女兒的身世三緘其口，讓一段揮之不去的夢魘深藏內心，一方面出於羞辱感，另一方面無法面對孩子的生父作為一個公眾人物給我心靈帶來的扭曲。）
With your help, the truth of our experience will be told. When it is, I hope justice will prevail. This is why I’m emerging from the shadows.
（因您伸出援手，我將得以說出這段真實的經歷。當真相大白的那一天到來，我希望正義能夠隨之彰顯。）
In 2000, I was a journalist working for a local Chinese newspaper in Los Angeles. I was assigned to interview a famous Chinese dissident, a political refugee in America, who people called the “Godfather of the Democratic Movement in China.” I wrote the story, but in doing so, my life was changed forever by his sexual assault of me.
（2000年，身為洛杉磯當地一家中文媒體記者的我，被派去採訪一位著名的中國異議人士，也是我本人非常敬仰的政治流亡者、一位被視為「中國民主運動之父」的風雲人物。我完成了採訪任務，然而我的個人生活卻因今生與他這唯一的遭逢而徹底脫軌。）
Let’s just say, nine months after I did that story, I gave birth to my daughter, who bore no resemblance to my then-husband. My husband knew why since I’d told him about the sexual assault after it happened. My marriage ended, and my life as a single mom began. To protect my daughter and me from possible backlash about how she was conceived and her father’s identity, I kept my ordeal quiet. The two of us moved to Hong Kong.
（在我做了那次採訪的9個月之後，我的女兒降生了。她跟我當時的丈夫長得一點也不像，而我丈夫也並不感到驚訝，因為我早跟他坦白了我遭遇性侵的事。我的婚姻其實從那時起已名存實亡，我作為一個單親母親的生涯也即將開始。為了遠離各種因孩子身世而產生的猜忌，讓我和孩子可以過安靜而屬於自己的生活，同時也為了可以就近得到父母家人的幫忙照顧，我帶著孩子離開了美國，赴香港尋找發展機會。）
Through the years I never thought about contacting my daughter's biological father, whom I met only once. I didn’t consider doing this even after I lost my job as an editor in 2012. But then a former colleague, Beifeng, left Hong Kong for the United States. He’d criticized me for "depriving the child the right to be recognized by her father," and later persuaded me to let him bring a lock of my daughter’s hair, wrapped it in tissue paper, that he took with him to the United States.
（多年來，我從未想過要聯絡孩子的生父，那個我只見過一面的人，哪怕是2012年我失業的時候也沒萌生這個打算。我根本已經忘記了這個人，要不是當時正要動身赴美的前同事北風（我告訴了他我的孩子生父是誰，但沒有讓他知道詳情，他也沒有探問）批評我「剝奪孩子認父的權利」。他太太當即揪了孩子幾根頭髮，用手紙包了起來。）
Months later, my heart sank when Beifeng reported back to me that this man had denied everything, even the possibility of knowing me, let alone the possibility of having fathered a child. He’d committed this horrible crime against me, but he refused to acknowledge this truth. For to accept that he’d fathered a daughter, he’d have to admit how she came to existence. It appeared that he was refusing to allow his carefully crafted story about his “heroic” life to be marred by acknowledging his daughter’s existence.
（幾個月之後，北風帶來消息並深表意外地說，孩子的生父得知自己可能有個孩子時的反應，竟是敷衍和閃躲，好像根本不可能有這回事一樣。他當然寧肯忘記自己做過的事，但真相怎麼能因你不想面對就可以不承認、孩子怎麼可以就這樣當她不存在呢？就像他後來在郵件裡提到的，他所關切的，是這事將來在他的回憶錄裡該怎麼寫，而不是他身為人父應該盡什麼責。他在意的只是他自己英雄般的人生，無論如何不能留下任何污點。）
After this news reached me, I was diagnosed with clinical depression and started to see a doctor regularly. Professionally, however, I had to appear calm and collected so I could earn a living that would support the two of us. I worked as a freelance writer and translator, while also raising my daughter on my own.
（我聞訊心裡沉了一下，不久開始意識恍惚，甚至試過下班下車記不起回家的方向。我遠在北京的母親聽說之後，在電話的另一頭啜泣得聲音哽咽。2013年2月，我被確診患上抑鬱症。失業更兼病倒，令我們母女的生計雪上加霜，這期間我成為自由撰稿人，還要硬撐著努力譯書維持生計。好在偶爾有父母幫手、妹妹接濟一下，才度過了一段危機。）
Five years later, in 2018, in the midst of #MeToo movement, when sexual abuse and harassment were receiving public attention globally, rumors spread online about this famous Chinese man having fathered an illegitimate child. At that point, I contacted him by phone from Hong Kong and boldly asked for child support.
（一晃又過了5年，時間到了2018年，在#MeToo（「我也是受害者」）運動的聲浪中，性侵和性騷擾現象的普遍存在引起了全球性輿論關注。在此期間，網上首次出現了對我女兒的生父「不認親」的議論。已變得反應遲緩的我這才開始應對，邁出了主動聯繫孩子生父這一步。）
He agreed to a DNA test that was performed privately in Washington D.C.., The DNA results proved that he was Charlotte's father. The person who shared the results with him said that he had responded positively to having a daughter. Accordingly, when I contacted him again, he promised to assist us by at least paying for her education. But later on, since I would not change my tone on the unhappy encounter with him in the past, he decided to deny being Charlotte’s father and began to challenge the DNA results, shirked his responsibility as her biological father, and ignored that I was a victim of his violent sexual assault.
（他於是主動提出做個DNA鑑定，並指定了一位背景相當可靠的前白宮幕僚做中間人，在華盛頓特區進行了DNA樣本的收集與鑑定。結果出來後，中間人率先通知我，說結果證明魏先生是孩子的生父無疑，並告訴我，魏先生對鑑定結果表示認可並顯得「很開心」。據此，在我與孩子的生父再次聯繫時，他表示自己起碼會負擔孩子的大學學費。但真到了時候他又變卦了，甚至仗著沒有把DNA鑑定結果如約給我們，便想將已經做過DNA鑑定這事也想賴掉。）
The rest of the story is detailed in Huaizhao Liu v. Jingsheng Wei, case #1:19-cv-03344, which was heard in the Washington, D.C. federal court. Charlotte’s father managed to find the funds necessary to hire a high-powered defense attorney to help him to deny both our dignity and his basic obligations of paternity.
（後來的事情見華盛頓特區聯邦法院卷宗（Case Number 1:19-cv-03344）。我女兒的生父大手筆聘請了專攻白領犯罪辯護的名牌大狀為自己的辯護律師，竭力搬弄法律條文進行技術性規避，想就此永遠掩蓋真相，踐踏我們母女的權益與尊嚴。）
We believe that Charlotte’s biological father should be forced to keep his promise of supporting her education, and we are asking that he release the DNA test results to us. His 19-year old daughter deserves to know the truth.
（我們堅信，法庭應該為這位竭力否認已經做過親子鑑定的生父驗明正身，然後強制他履行他的諾言，承擔他女兒的學費。我們堅信，他19歲的女兒有權利知曉真相。）
The weight of evidence is on our side, but we risk losing the lawsuit that we are filing against him if we cannot raise the money we need to hire an attorney who is as capable as his lawyer. What is at risk is Charlotte's right to a quality education, along with the legally binding acknowledgement of his paternity.
（儘管我們掌握活生生的證據，但如果籌不到聘請律師的費用，單憑我們自訴，將無法應對複雜的陪審團庭審程序。立案至今一年多來，被告採取躲和拖的戰術，先是躲傳票，然後提出「司法管轄權」爭議逼我們撤案，一計不成又援引「多國籍」條款，將案子從特區高等法院轉移到聯邦法院。）
With your assistance – with your contributions – we intend to hire an attorney who is experienced in sexual assault and paternity cases. We hope to win this #MeToo case and pursue respectful, equal and democratic human relationship in Chinese community.
（您的捐助將幫助我們聘請到專攻性侵案和親子案官司的律師，幫我們贏得這場事關尊嚴、平等、人權以及人性的人身傷害官司，並藉此推動美國的華人社區乃至全球華人的觀念進步與行為的現代化。）
Here are some online stories and commentary about this, in Chinese:
https://www.storm.mg/article/2891777?mode=whole
(by Liao Yiwu, award winner of Human Rights Watch Hellman-Hammett Grant 2003, the German Geschwister-Scholl-Preis 2011 and the Peace Prize of the German Book Trade 2012.)
（作者/廖亦武，詩人、流亡作家與底層歷史記錄者。2012年德國書業和平獎得主，並曾獲美國《當代基督教》雜誌頒發的「最佳圖書奬」、德國書業協會頒發的「紹爾兄妹獎」、德國廣播協會頒發的「最佳廣播劇奬」及德國阿夏芬堡頒發的「公民勇氣奬」。2013年，法國政府頒發給廖亦武「法蘭西文學藝術軍官獎章」。2018年，廖亦武獲美國紐約瓦茨拉夫 哈維爾圖書基金會頒發「無懼危難作家獎」。）
http://minzhuzhongguo.org/MainArtShow.aspx?AID=105641
(by Qi JIazhen, writer in exile, author of autobiographical series: Tears of the Goddess of Liberty and Red Dog. Qi is the Chairwoman of the Women Writers committee, Independent Chinese PEN Center.)
（作者/齊家貞，流亡作家，著有系列傳記《自由神的眼泪──父女两代囚徒的真實故事》（後改名《黑牆裡的倖存者》和《紅狗：—個被釋女囚的真實故事》在香港和台灣出版。齊家貞曾先後擔任國際筆會獨立中文筆會理事會理事、副會長、秘書長等職務，並在澳洲建立了“齊氏文化基金會”，每年頒發“推動中國進步獎”截至2019年已連續頒獎12屆。）
https://liuvswei.blogspot.com/2020/08/metoo.html
(by Lau Kayee, Chairwoman of Network for Women In Politics, Hong Kong; Spokeswoman of Hong Kong Civil Human Rights Front.)
（作者/劉家儀，香港婦女參政網絡主席，六四新生代秘書長，支聯會常委，香港市民捍衛人權陣線發言人。）
With your contributions, we will be able to set a positive example for #MeToo victims by raising awareness about women’s and children's rights, globally.
因您的資助，我們將能夠為#MeToo運動傷害者們建立一個積極的個案，為提高女性及孩童的權利意識而有所貢獻。

content:
Fundraiser by Boston Standswithhk : US Hong Kong Safe Harbor Postcard Campaign
Boston Standswithhk is organizing this fundraiser.
***When donation, make as anonymous if you wish to hide the donator's name and make the TIPS to 0.00***
While US-China tensions continue to escalate and the November presidential elections loom near, as Hongkongers living in the United States (or any informed person in the world), we must not forget or turn a blind eye to the CCP’s continuous oppression on Hongkongers and other minority groups in China, such as Uyghurs, Tibetans, and Mongolians. With the promulgation of the new National Security Law on June 30, 2020, the government has since been arresting and charging dissidents with these vaguely-worded laws that may entail life imprisonment. In the past month alone, 12 Hong Kongers fleeing protest-related charges have been detained in China and denied meetings with lawyers since August 23, 2020; Legislative Council elections had been postponed a year in the name of “public health concerns” amidst a mass arrest of candidates; media mogul Jimmy Lai, who runs the only pro-democratic print newspaper in Hong Kong, has been arrested with the National Security Law; and the Education Bureau has begun actively censoring content they deemed politically incorrect in Liberal Studies textbooks, including concepts like “civil disobedience” and “separation of powers”, and images of Lennon Walls. Up until today, the administration has arrested more than 10,000 Hong Kongers, charged over 2,200, deployed water cannons, fired more than 16,000 tear gas canisters and over 10,000 rubber bullets against its own people. Freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and political rights as we knew it have been thoroughly eroded.
11月的美國總統大選逐漸逼近，中美關係日漸緊張，作為居住在美國的香港人或是在這個世界上任何有良知的人，面對中共對香港、維吾爾族、藏族和蒙古族的持續壓逼，我們不能容忍，更不能視而不見。自2020年6月30日頒布《國家安全法》以來，政府持續逮捕異見人​​士，並以措辭含糊的法律起訴抗爭者，香港的司法制度已經徹底淪為政府的打壓工具。及後更有12名香港抗爭者為了逃離這種不公義的審判欲流亡台灣，卻被中共非法拘捕。他們無法與律師會面，音訊全無。而香港人僅有的發聲方法——立法會選舉，卻因為「公共衛生風險」而被推遲一年；同時間，大批候選人被逮捕或是被拒絕參選。作為香港唯一異見紙媒《蘋果日報》的老闆黎智英被警方高調逮捕，《蘋果日報》總部更被大肆搜查。教育局亦積極審查通識科教科書中所謂的「政治不正確」內容，例如「公民抗命」和「三權分立」的概念，以及連儂牆相片。到今天為止，已經有超過10,000多名香港人被捕、2,200多人被起訴，警方向市民發射了超過16,000枚催淚彈和10,000多發橡皮子彈，令香港人長期生活在恐懼中。香港人的言論自由、集會自由和政治權利已被徹底侵蝕。
In light of the deteriorating situation, we plan to kickstart a new round of postcard campaign urging Congress to pass two bills related to Hong Kong as soon as possible - Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act (H.R.7415/S.4110), and Hong Kong People’s Freedom and Choice Act (H.R.7428/S.4229):
鑑於情況日益惡化，我們希望透過郵寄明信片給國會議員的方式，呼籲他們盡快通過兩項與香港有關的法案 —— 香港安全港法案 (H.R.7415 / S.4110) 和香港人民自由與選擇法(H.R.7428 / S.4229):
The Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act will designate certain Hong Kong residents who are victims of persecution or who have a well-founded fear of future persecution because of their peaceful political activities as Priority 2 refugees (excluded from refugee cap), allowing them and their spouses, children, parents to apply to the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for protection. (Click here for more details)
《香港安全港法案》將指定某些遭受迫害，或因其參與和平的政治活動而感到恐懼的香港居民列為「優先級別2」的難民，且不受每年限額限制，亦允許他們及其配偶、子女、父母向「美國難民接納計劃」申請庇護。(詳情請瀏覽)
The Hong Kong People's Freedom and Choice Act will provide Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hong Kongers, maintain Hong Kong’s status as autonomous for the purposes of immigration, provide special and expedited status for certain high-skilled Hong Kongers as well as expedite Permanent Resident status for Hong Kongers residing in the US. (Click here for more details)
《香港人民自由與選擇法》會為香港人提供臨時保護身份（TPS），維持香港在移民方面的自治地位，亦為部分香港專業人仕提供特殊和快速的身份，並加快辦理香港人的美國永久居民(綠卡)身份的程序。(詳情請瀏覽)
In our last postcard campaign pushing for the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, we delivered over 3000 postcards to Congress. We aren’t part of any formal organization and do not have operation funds. We desperately call for your contribution again to help us deliver these postcards to Congress, to remind them of Hong Kong’s urgent situation and urge them to take immediate action. Your contribution would support our printing and delivery costs. Thank you so much!
在上一次推動《香港人權與民主法》的明信片運動中，我們向國會送出了超過3000張的明信片。我們不是任何正式組織的成員，也沒有運營資金，所以我們竭誠呼籲您為我們提供資金，並幫助我們將這些明信片送交您們所屬的國會議員，提醒他們香港的緊急狀況，並呼籲他們立即採取行動。所有受到的捐款將支持我們的打印和交付成本。萬分感謝！

# READOUT: Pacific Fleet Commander’s travel to Tonga, Nov. 17-19

18 November 2026

## From U.S. Pacific Fleet Public Affairs

 U.S. Navy Adm. Steve Koehler, commander, U.S. Pacific Fleet, traveled to Nuku’alofa, Tonga, Nov. 17-19 to reaffirm the longstanding partnership and deepening defense ties between the Kingdom of Tonga and the United States in support of shared maritime security and regional stability.

title: 渾水做空英偉達 質疑前高管涉對華芯片銷售
summary: 黃仁勳近日辭退輝達執行長，沽空機構渾水宣布做空正陷入涉華調查風波的美國芯片企業英偉達。（宋碧龍／大紀元） 【大紀元2026年11月19日訊】（大紀元記者林燕報導）週二（11月17日），沽空機構渾水（Muddy Waters）發布一份名為「NVIDIA: More China」的12頁報告（點擊），宣布做空正陷入涉華調查風波的美國芯片企業英偉達。 報告聚焦英偉達前全球業務執行副總裁傑伊‧普里（Ajay「Jay」Puri）與超微電腦（Super Micro Computer）前首
content:
黃仁勳近日辭退輝達執行長，沽空機構渾水宣布做空正陷入涉華調查風波的美國芯片企業英偉達。（宋碧龍／大紀元）
【大紀元2026年11月19日訊】（大紀元記者林燕報導）週二（11月17日），沽空機構渾水（Muddy Waters）發布一份名為「NVIDIA: More China」的12頁報告（點擊），宣布做空正陷入涉華調查風波的美國芯片企業英偉達。
報告聚焦英偉達前全球業務執行副總裁傑伊‧普里（Ajay「Jay」Puri）與超微電腦（Super Micro Computer）前首席增長官陳岑麗（Cenly Chen）之間的關係，並將兩人的業務職責與超微相關人士涉嫌違規向中國轉運服務器（GPU）的案件聯繫起來。
渾水引述2026年10月在加州提出的一項針對超微的集體訴訟，稱陳岑麗在任職期間負責管理向英偉達採購GPU芯片，並「決定如何將這些英偉達GPU分配給超微的客戶」。陳岑麗於2026年4月底或5月初離開超微。
另據「The Information」週三（18日）報導，普里與陳岑麗今年曾向同事表示兩人已結婚。此外，普里曾掌握英偉達向超微等客戶供應AI芯片的數量。兩人的私人關係進一步引發涉嫌芯片採購、分配及利益披露方面的疑問。
渾水報告披露了2024年至2026年間的一組公開活動照片（點擊）。與普里同框的同一名女性，在不同照片中被標註為Cenly Chen或Cenly Puri。報告將這些照片與超微前高管陳岑麗的訪問影像並列，追問兩者是否為同一人。
渾水表示，曾向代表陳岑麗現任職公司Chronoscale的投資者關係機構詢問此事，但截至報告發布時未獲回覆。
「The Information」則引述參與英偉達伺服器銷售的人士的話報導，普里與陳岑麗的關係已持續多年，兩人今年也曾向同事表示已婚。不過，該媒體未能確認兩人何時結婚，兩人亦未回覆置評請求。
這段婚姻還引發披露問題。「The Information」引述一名證券律師的意見稱，如果普里在被列為英偉達主要具名高管期間，已與仍任職超微的陳岑麗結婚或共同居住，便有充分理由認為英偉達需要在證券文件中披露這項關係。該報稱，英偉達申報文件中沒有此類披露。
但由於兩人的結婚時間尚未確認，目前仍不能據此認定英偉達違反披露義務。
2024年12月5日，越南總理范明正（右二）在河內政府辦公廳會見時任英偉達首席執行官兼創辦人黃仁勳（左二）、英偉達執行副總裁Jay Puri（左一）。(STR/AFP via Getty Images)
普里並非英偉達的一般銷售主管。據渾水報告，他曾負責英偉達全球銷售、業務拓展、合作夥伴聯盟、解決方案架構及支援服務等業務，是公司最資深的高管之一，卸下行政職務後仍擔任資深顧問。
渾水依據他的職責、薪酬及公司披露，研判他在2026年6月前可能是僅次於黃仁勳與柯萊特‧克雷斯（Colette Kress）的第三號高管。
「The Information」引述熟悉英偉達AI芯片銷售的人士稱，普里掌握英偉達向超微及其他伺服器製造商出售芯片的數量。報導也引述熟悉超微營運的人士的話，稱陳岑麗是管理超微與英偉達關係的團隊成員，並向超微執行長梁見後（Charles Liang）報告。
報導另引述曾與陳岑麗共事的人士的話，稱一些服務中國客戶的英偉達芯片轉售商熟悉她，或試圖與她建立關係。
超微對此提出反駁。公司否認陳岑麗管理超微與英偉達的關係，也否認她決定如何向客戶分配英偉達GPU，並表示她是自願離職，轉任Chronoscale執行長。
除了人物關係及業務職責，相關民事訴訟還提出涉及郵件與芯片序號的指控。
「The Information」引述超微股東的民事訴狀內容稱，一名前超微銷售主管表示，公司內部普遍知道，陳岑麗的離職與她曾發送郵件、要求英偉達放行特定芯片有關；相關芯片序號被指與違規轉運至中國的GPU相連。
渾水報告亦有引述該訴狀的指控稱，「陳岑麗不可能對（超微的）非法銷售毫不知情。」但渾水也明確指出，這些民事指控尚未獲得證實，沒有名叫Cenly Chen的人士遭任何政府刑事起訴或指控犯罪。
目前提供的材料並未呈現完整郵件，也未證明普里曾收到或批准相關要求。
這些指控的背景，是美國針對超微相關人士提出的一宗刑事案件。2026年3月，三名與超微有關的人士，包括一名共同創辦人，被控通過東南亞中間公司，將搭載受管制AI芯片的服務器違規轉運中國。
渾水引述司法部的起訴書說，一家中間公司在2024年至2025年之間採購了約25億美元服務器。其中，僅2025年4月底至同年5月中旬，有至少約5.1億美元的服務器被違規轉運至中國。
普里未被指控存在不當行為，或知悉相關違規。超微則強調，公司本身並非該刑事起訴的被告，並表示設有合規制度。英偉達此前亦表示遵守美國出口管制，其盡職調查曾協助發現涉嫌規避限制的行為。
據《商業內幕》（Business Insider）報導，渾水執行長卡森‧布洛克（Carson Block）表示，這次做空並非基於對英偉達基本面或估值的判斷，而是希望促使公司公開表態，說明是否了解相關問題。
渾水表示，計劃在報告發布後開始回補大部分、甚至全部英偉達空頭部位，並稱此舉出於風險管理，而非對報告觀點失去信心。
在渾水之前，Culper Research已於今年稍早披露做空英偉達，關注其中國業務曝險，以及黃仁勳與黃樂（Alice Huang）、新加坡數據中心公司Megaspeed等相關的問題。
黃樂與黃仁勳有親密關係。英偉達董事會正在調查這段關係，包括她是否曾向中共情報機構傳遞來自黃仁勳的信息。
美國商務部和司法部均表示，正在調查涉及包括Megaspeed等英偉達客戶向中國違規轉運芯片的問題。

summary: 资料照片：位于德国柏林的梅赛德斯·奔驰集团的标识。(2021年6月25日) 国会众议院美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会两党领袖对梅赛德斯-奔驰集团(Mercedes-Benz)与中国共产党相关实体的联系启动调查。目前国会正在审议禁止中国汽车进入美国市场的法案。 该特设委员会主席、密歇根州共和党籍联邦众议员约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)与资深成员、加利福尼州民主党籍联邦众议员罗·卡纳(Ro Khanna)星期二(11月17日)联名致函梅赛德斯-奔驰集团北美分部
content:
资料照片：位于德国柏林的梅赛德斯·奔驰集团的标识。(2021年6月25日)
国会众议院美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会两党领袖对梅赛德斯-奔驰集团(Mercedes-Benz)与中国共产党相关实体的联系启动调查。目前国会正在审议禁止中国汽车进入美国市场的法案。
该特设委员会主席、密歇根州共和党籍联邦众议员约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)与资深成员、加利福尼州民主党籍联邦众议员罗·卡纳(Ro Khanna)星期二(11月17日)联名致函梅赛德斯-奔驰集团北美分部首席执行官贾森·霍夫(Jason Hoff)和这家总部位于德国的汽车巨头的董事长兼首席执行官康林松(Ola Källenius)，要求提供相关记录和信息，包括与北京汽车集团(BAIC）、吉利(Geely)创始人李书福以及其他中国企业之间的关系。
两位众议员提到，据报道，北汽集团和与李书福相关企业分别持有梅赛德斯-奔驰近10%的股份，合计持股比例约为20%，且在股东大会上所拥有的投票权份额很可能更高。
他们在信中写道：“这些记录和回复不仅有助于本特设委员会对汽车行业的国家安全及供应链风险进行监督，还将提供信息，帮助国会审议立法，以缓解中华人民共和国的汽车对美国市场所构成的严重威胁。”
合成资料照片：众议院中国问题特设委员会主席约翰·穆勒纳尔(左)与首席民主党成员罗·卡纳
该委员会表示对这些中国实体可能产生的影响力及其获取信息的能力表示关切，特别是考虑到北汽是中国国有企业，而吉利在中国旨在主导全球汽车市场的战略中扮演主导角色。这次调查还将审视梅赛德斯-奔驰与中国企业之间不断扩大的技术合作关系，这些公司包括禾赛(Hesai)、腾讯(Tencent)与北京初速度科技有限公司(Momenta)。
除其他事项外，该委员会寻求了解以下方面的信息：北京对梅赛德斯-奔驰战略决策的影响、技术共享情况、中华人民共和国实体获取梅赛德斯-奔驰专有研发成果的途径、在美国生产或销售的车辆中所使用的中国产零部件以及该公司与中华人民共和国政府官员的接触。
该委员会要求梅赛德斯-奔驰在12月1日前提供记录和信息，并保存所有与调查相关的文件和电子通信。
路透社(Reuters)星期二报道说，梅赛德斯-奔驰在一份声明中表示，已收到信函并将配合调查。声明还强调，该公司“长期以来一直支持维护美国国家安全的举措，任何有关本公司反对这些目标的说法都是不正确的。”
任期即将届满的本届国会正在审议一项立法，旨在加强阻止中国汽车进入美国的禁令。
在众议院和参议院得到两党议员支持的《联网车辆安全法》(Connected Vehicle Security Act)拟全面禁止包括中国在内的“外国敌手”的联网汽车、软件、硬件及关键零部件进入美国市场。这部法案今年7月在参议院商务委员会过关，但随后没有出现更多立法进展。
代表主要汽车制造商的组织--汽车创新联盟(Alliance for Automotive Innovation)的负责人今年9月致函两院两党领袖，敦促国会抓紧时间，在年底前通过《联网车辆安全法案》等法案，禁止中国联网汽车及其软硬件进入美国市场。
按照参议院商务委员会通过的版本，中国实体所有权超过15%的企业将被禁止在美国出售汽车。彭博社(Bloomberg)曾报道说，中国公司拥有重大股权的梅赛德斯-奔驰展开游说努力，争取修改法案内容。
路透社星期二的报道提到，该法案发起人之一--俄亥俄州共和党籍联邦参议员伯尼·莫雷诺(Bernie Moreno)表示，法案最后版本将确保梅赛德斯-奔驰不会在美国被禁，他希望国会最快本星期就能通过该法案。
穆勒纳尔众议员也是这部跨党法案的发起人之一。他和卡纳在给梅赛德斯-奔驰领导人的信中还要求就相关事宜进行一次事关国会行使监督权的会议，并要求霍夫亲自与会。
穆勒纳尔与卡纳在信中提到，根据众议院决议，“本特设委员会拥有广泛授权，可就应对中国共产党对美国及其盟友和伙伴在经济、技术、安全和意识形态方面构成的威胁进行调查，并提交政策建议。”
众议院美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会简称中国问题特设委员会，成立于2023年1月。有报道说，11月3日中期选举后赢得新国会控制权的民主党人正在考虑该委员会的去留。
新一届国会任期将在2027年1月3日开始。共和党人穆勒纳尔和民主党人卡纳均当选连任。

content:
台湾核公投前能源安全争议 - 聚焦台湾
台湾核公投前的能源安全和安全争论
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中央选举委员会供图
中新社台北11月18日电 在台湾11月28日就结束无核能源政策进行公投之前，周三，一名支持核的立法者和一名反对重启核反应堆的地质学家在电视演讲中就能源安全、电力成本和地震风险发生争执。
演讲中，台湾人民党立委洪毓祥表示支持该提案，而台湾地热协会常务理事王守诚表示反对。
这是中央选举委员会就全民投票问题组织的五场电视演讲中的第四场：“你是否支持政府利用核能振兴经济并废除‘无核家园’能源政策？”
此次公投由主要反对党国民党提出，并得到TPP的支持，但遭到执政的民进党（DPP）的反对。
洪宣扬核电批评民进党能源政策
洪说，核电对于提供稳定的低碳电力至关重要，以满足台湾半导体和人工智能（AI）行业不断增长的电力需求。
洪说：“一个国家的实力取决于其计算能力，而计算能力又取决于电力。”他援引政府预测，未来十年电力需求将平均每年增长2.5%。
他补充说：“这是过去十年平均增长率的两倍多，台湾每年需要增加超过 70 亿千瓦时的电力。”
洪指责民进党未能实现其可再生能源目标，导致电价上涨并继续严重依赖化石燃料。
他还批评民进党政府尽管长期以来致力于逐步淘汰核电，但仍考虑重启此前关闭的核反应堆，尽管该党敦促选民拒绝公投提案。
洪说：“这种180度的转变根本没有意义。”他认为政府立场的转变让公众感到困惑。
在能源安全方面，洪说，台湾对进口液化天然气的依赖使其在台海封锁时很容易受到供应中断的影响。
他说：“保留核电意味着维持最后一道防线，防止威胁国家安全的停电。”他认为，与天然气不同，核燃料可以储存多年。
王警告地质风险和核电重启成本高昂
国立台湾海洋大学研究员王反驳说，台湾地震多发地区核电站的地质灾害尚未得到充分解决，并指出设施下方或附近的断层结构。
王说：“地震、台风和断层不会因为公投而消失。”他辩称，政府和台电的报告已经确定了所有四个核电站厂址的地质风险。
他特别提到了屏东县的马鞍山核电站，声称两座反应堆都位于不稳定的地质结构上，台电最近钻探的五个钻孔揭示了断层剪切带。
瓦

Energy security, safety debated ahead of Taiwan's nuclear referendum - Focus Taiwan
Energy security, safety debated ahead of Taiwan's nuclear referendum
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Photo courtesy of the Central Election Commission
Taipei, Nov. 18 (CNA) A pro-nuclear lawmaker and a geologist opposed to restarting nuclear reactors sparred Wednesday over energy security, electricity costs and earthquake risks during a televised presentation ahead of Taiwan's Nov. 28 referendum on ending the country's nuclear-free energy policy.
The presentation featured Taiwan People's Party (TPP) Legislator Hung Yu-hsiang (洪毓祥) arguing in favor of the proposal and Wang Shou-cheng (王守誠), a standing director of the Taiwan Geothermal Association, speaking against it.
It was the fourth of five televised presentations organized by the Central Election Commission on the referendum question: "Do you support the government revitalizing the economy with nuclear energy and abolishing the 'nuclear-free homeland' energy policy?"
The referendum was proposed by the main opposition Kuomintang and backed by the TPP, but opposed by the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP).
Hung touts nuclear power, criticizes DPP energy policy
Hung said nuclear power was essential to providing stable, low-carbon electricity to meet growing electricity demand from Taiwan's semiconductor and artificial intelligence (AI) industries.
"A country's strength depends on its computing power, which in turn depends on electricity," Hung said, citing government forecasts that electricity demand would grow by an average of 2.5 percent annually over the next decade.
"This is more than double the average growth rate over the past decade, with Taiwan needing over 7 billion additional kilowatt-hours of electricity each year," he added.
Hung accused the DPP of failing to meet its renewable energy targets, allowing electricity prices to rise and continuing to rely heavily on fossil fuels.
He also criticized the DPP government for considering restarting previously shut-down nuclear reactors despite its longstanding commitment to phasing out nuclear power, even as the party urged voters to reject the referendum proposal.
"This 180-degree turn simply makes no sense," Hung said, arguing that the government's shifting position had left the public confused.
On energy security, Hung said Taiwan's dependence on imported liquefied natural gas made it vulnerable to supply disruptions in the event of a blockade of the Taiwan Strait.
"Keeping nuclear power means maintaining a last line of defense against power outages that threaten national security," he said, arguing that nuclear fuel could be stored for years, unlike natural gas.
Wang warns of geological risks, high nuclear restart costs
Wang, a researcher at National Taiwan Ocean University, countered that geological hazards at nuclear power plants in earthquake-prone Taiwan had not been adequately addressed, citing fault structures beneath or near the facilities.
"Earthquakes, typhoons and faults do not disappear because of a referendum," Wang said, arguing that government and Taiwan Power Co. (Taipower) reports had identified geological risks at all four nuclear plant sites.
He singled out the Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant in Pingtung County, claiming that both reactors were located on unstable geological structures and that five boreholes recently drilled by Taipower had revealed fault shear zones.
Wang also questioned the feasibility of restarting aging reactors, arguing that replacing old equipment and completing safety inspections could cost several hundred billion New Taiwan dollars and take at least five to 10 years.
He also argued that Taiwan lacked a domestic nuclear power industry supply chain and relied on imported technology and equipment, meaning that restarting aging reactors would require customized components for repairs and upgrades.
Citing California's Diablo Canyon Nuclear Power Plant, Wang said extending its operations by five years could cost as much as NT$390 billion (US$11.8 billion), illustrating the engineering challenges and high costs of extending nuclear reactors' operating lives.
The Maanshan nuclear plant in Pintung County. CNA file photo
Taiwan shut down its last operating reactor at the Maanshan plant on May 17, 2025, fulfilling a longstanding pledge by the DPP, which has been in power since 2016, to phase out nuclear power.
On March 21, President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) said the Ministry of Economic Affairs had determined that the Maanshan plant and the No. 2 Nuclear Power Plant in New Taipei's Wanli District met the requirements to begin the reactor restart process.
The president cited rising electricity demand driven by AI, the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and growing geopolitical risks, while reaffirming his support for renewable energy.
On Sept. 24, the Nuclear Safety Commission approved Taipower's plan to restart the Maanshan plant, although further safety assessments are required before the plant can resume operations.
The fifth and final presentation will be held at 7 p.m. Friday, with pro-nuclear power activist Huang Shih-hsiu (黃士修) speaking in favor of the referendum and Teng Yu-yu (鄧宇佑), a spokesperson for Citizens of the Earth, Taiwan, speaking against it.
